Workspace layout.orchestration: Turborepo for JS; Cargo separate; Makefile wrappers at repo root

Package manager.preference: Bun via Corepack preferred; fall back to Corepack pnpm + Turborepo if Bun pin unreliable

Compose topology.services: web + api + postgres (default) + mysql via Compose profile + sqlite via env/file
Compose topology.db_crate: octanest-db uniform adapter for Postgres, MySQL, SQLite
Compose topology.routing: Traefik reverse proxy in Compose; Vite/TanStack Start proxy for local make dev
